nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd: public pure addition helper that stores c = a + b and requires c >= a to reject overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: public pure subtraction helper that requires b <= a and stores c = a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul: public pure multiplication helper that stores c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv: public pure division helper that requires b > 0 and stores c = a / b.
Owned constructor assigning the deployer (msg.sender) as the initial owner.
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function staging a new owner in newOwner after rejecting the zero address.
Owned.acceptOwnership: lets the pending newOwner finalize the ownership transfer and clears newOwner.
Token constructor minting the whole supply to a fixed address and setting symbol, name and decimals.
ERC20 totalSupply returning _totalSupply minus the balance held by the zero address.
ERC20 balanceOf returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to the recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emitting Transfer.
ERC20 approve setting allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emitting Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom moving tokens with allowance bookkeeping via safeSub/safeAdd and a zero-address check on the recipient.
ERC20 allowance returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall setting an allowance and then invoking the spender contract through receiveApproval (untrusted external call).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function that performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call to tokenAddress.
Token ticker symbol string, set to "DCC" in the constructor.
Token display name string, set to "DesignerClubCoin" in the constructor.
Token decimal precision (18) used when computing the total supply.
Total token supply storage variable written in the constructor and read by totalSupply.
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
Current contract owner address used by the onlyOwner authorization check.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership initialization, authorization checks and balance/allowance keying.
Unsigned addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by a == 0 || c / a == b.
Unsigned division c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Access-control requirement require(msg.sender == owner) enforced by the onlyOwner modifier on privileged functions.
Access-control requirement require(msg.sender == newOwner) gating acceptOwnership.
Untrusted external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance state update, a reentrancy vector.
Arbitrary external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) with a caller-supplied token contract.
Supply arithmetic 10000000000 * 10 ** uint256(decimals) computed in the constructor.
